## Boot Configuration & Patching Tools (CoCo-specific)

OS-9 allocates memory to loaded modules in 8K blocks regardless of a module's actual size - a merged file under 8K wastes nothing, but splitting related modules across separate loads costs a full block each. This is why the standard shell (just under 8K on its own) is typically merged with other frequently-used commands up to, but not past, the 8K boundary. T
